subject.title: fix(usage): price usage rows with the owning agent's model registry

question: Should this PR intentionally recalculate existing multi-agent cost and budget outputs from each row’s owning agent registry after a real upgrade-style proof confirms the behavior?
rationale: The correction is plausible, but it changes user-visible accounting totals and cache/rollup invalidation behavior for established multi-agent deployments; the protected label requires explicit maintainer handling.

options.title: Require multi-agent replay proof
options.body: Keep the agent-scoped design, but require a redacted real run showing two agents with different local prices and the resulting rollup or budget values before merge.

options.title: Accept test-only evidence
options.body: Merge based on the submitted regression tests while accepting that existing installations may discover changed accounting totals only after recomputation.

recommendation.title: Require multi-agent replay proof
recommendation.body: Keep the agent-scoped design, but require a redacted real run showing two agents with different local prices and the resulting rollup or budget values before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the proposed pricing and rollup changes and are the clearest available contact for supplying the requested runtime evidence.
